semantics.clock: All state updates occur on the positive edge of clk; one input bit is sampled per edge when reset is low.
semantics.reset: Active-high synchronous reset takes priority over in and sets a state equivalent to having just received zero. All outputs are low after the reset edge.
semantics.initialization: No power-up state is specified; a reset edge establishes defined behavior.
semantics.disc: Assert for the full cycle immediately following sampling a zero preceded by exactly five consecutive ones.
semantics.flag: Assert for the full cycle immediately following sampling a zero preceded by exactly six consecutive ones.
semantics.err: Assert for the full cycle immediately following sampling the seventh consecutive one and remain asserted on each further one. A sampled zero clears err and starts new zero-based history.
semantics.moore: Outputs depend only on registered state, never directly on current in. A terminating zero for disc or flag also establishes zero history for subsequent sequences. Outputs are mutually exclusive.

numeric.data: All ports are unsigned single bits; no payload arithmetic, rounding, truncation or signed arithmetic is required.
numeric.history: Track run lengths zero through six and a saturated seven-or-more error state; never wrap long runs. Separate Moore states represent discard and flag after a zero.

verification.oracle: Independent testbench counts consecutive sampled ones, saturating at seven. On a zero it expects discard iff the previous count was five and flag iff six; on one it expects error iff the updated count is seven.
verification.directed: Check zero runs, one runs of lengths zero through twenty, terminating zeros, adjacent framing patterns, error recovery and reset from active/output states.
verification.exhaustive: Enumerate all binary input sequences of length twelve, resetting between sequences and comparing all outputs after every sampled edge.
verification.timing: Compare after nonblocking updates; change input/reset between positive edges and verify outputs hold until the next positive edge, including synchronous reset.
verification.tools: Icarus v12 with -g2012 and explicit dev_tb top, matching vvp, bounded compile/simulation execution and internal timeout. No official tests or synthesis.
